links.comparator_used: Scoring only the final diagnosis, as in standard benchmark accuracy and stepwise benchmarks that score diagnosis or information gathering
links.outcome: Detection of potentially harmful or clinically invalid intermediate decisions that final-diagnosis scoring misses
links.effect: 55.2% of hospital trajectories reaching an acceptable final diagnosis passed through a decision with moderate or severe potential harm, and 24.8% through a clinically unacceptable one; harm rates were 76.2% on MIMIC-IV and 39.6% on ASCENT
links.quote: A correct final diagnosis does not certify a safe trajectory, and a successful correction does not certify a safe recovery.

design_hint: corrective oversight feedback (structured correction vs bare rejection) and trajectory safety auditing
